changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6515-record-form-current-user-normaliser.md`

- names `console/AppContent.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The normaliser moved from `console/AppContent.tsx` to `providers/expressionUser.ts`, beside the `ExpressionProvider` it feeds. That move is what made the fix available: `RecordFormPage` is `lazy()`-loaded BY `AppContent`, so importing the normaliser from its old home would have put a static edge from the split chunk back into the module it was split out of. Both `console/AppContent.js` and the package entry re-export the name, so `buildExpressionUser` is published exactly as before.

### `.changeset/6559-expression-user-input-contract.md`

- names `console/AppContent.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` — edited by this change

  > NO RUNTIME BEHAVIOUR MOVES. All four in-repo production call sites pass `useAuth().user`, typed `AuthUser | null`, and type cleanly unchanged — two in `console/AppContent.tsx`, one in `views/RecordFormPage.tsx`, one in `apps/console`'s `InternalFormRoute.tsx`. The body is byte-equivalent: the same keys, the same `??` defaults, the same anonymous branch. ⛔ No consumer-side fallback was added; `id: u.id ?? null` remains the rejected shape (triage ruling 2026-08-26), because a lenient default in the consumer is what AGENTS.md #0.1 forbids and it silently equates "signed in, no id" with "signed out".

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `8cc0e2984` (merge-base with origin/main): 11 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1416 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1995 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36099504598)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0ebfc8ea76930b2066f45546cb8d4afadad42875`

`git rev-parse refs/review/pr-10507` = `0ebfc8ea7…` (branch has not moved). Merge-base with `refs/review/main` = `cdefa2a06` (the dev's cited base). Main is 16 commits ahead; `git log cdefa2a06..refs/review/main -- [12 PR files + AppSidebar/UnifiedSidebar/ConsoleShell/pages/system]` is empty, so the PR's evidence is not stale. Diff: 12 files, +212/−1009.

### ① Derived judgments

**The landing.** `SystemLandingRedirect` is `Navigate to="settings" replace` — a constant, not something re-derived from the navigation at runtime; the component's own comment admits it ("a reading taken once — nothing re-derives it"). It is a hard-coded single hop that lands on a page that IS registry-rendered, which satisfies the card's "或最简 registry 渲染" form and the seat's order ("choose a navigation-driven landing, name the evidence"), but it should be read as "one string that can drift" rather than "driven".

- Evidence verified, all three: objectstack `origin/main` (`fa00ebf44`) `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` L112 `nav_settings_hub` url `/apps/setup/system/settings`; objectui head `AppSidebar.tsx` L391 `sys-config` → `/apps/setup/system/settings`; `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` L365 `sys-config` same. `git grep "url: '/apps/setup/system'"` over objectstack `packages` = 0 hits, so no framework entry targets the bare URL. Caveat the PR omits: `nav_settings_hub` carries `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`, i.e. the framework hides "All Settings" from users without that permission, while all 7 objectui senders (user-menu "Settings", sidebar header, Quick Action, sys-settings ×2, empty-state button, `/system` bookmark) are ungated. Non-blocking: `GET /api/settings` is server-filtered per caller (ledger L75–76 "manifests the caller may see, filtered by their capabilities"), and Localization/Company/Branding read at `setup.access`, so such a caller gets a reduced hub, not a 403; a caller who sees zero manifests gets the `console.settingsHub.empty` card.
- SettingsHub: `listSettingsManifests()` → `fetch(SERVER_URL/api/settings)`; grouped by `manifest.category`, sorted by `order`. No hand-written list. (Pre-existing, not this PR: cards navigate to `/system/settings/${ns}` without the `/apps/:app` prefix and rely on `ConsoleShell.SystemRedirect` for the prefix.)
- Both branches: app-shell `AppContent.tsx` mounts `{extraRoutesNoApp}` (L1006, zero-app branch) and `{extraRoutes}` (L1122, with-app); console passes the same `systemRoutes` fragment to both (console `AppContent.tsx` L305). `system` and `system/settings` are therefore in both tables.
- Loops: relative `settings` resolves under the matched `…/system`, and `isSystemRoute = pathSegments.includes('system')` (L237) stays true for `…/system/settings`, so the zero-app branch keeps mounting the host fragment instead of falling into the empty state; pinned by the 4th new test (`chain` = `/apps/setup` → `/apps/setup/system` → `/apps/setup/system/settings`, `create-first-app-btn` absent). No loop found. Two small things the PR does not say: the legacy `/system` bookmark is now a two-hop chain (`SystemRedirect` → bare URL → settings), and `SystemRedirect` forwards `location.search`/`hash` which `SystemLandingRedirect` then drops — so the new component's comment "no producer sends either" is false for a `/system?…` bookmark (same pre-existing pattern as `SystemObjectRedirect`).

**Every sender.** `git grep` of the bare URL over `packages/app-shell/src` + `apps/console/src` (non-test) finds exactly 7 code senders: app-shell `AppContent.tsx` L960 (empty-state button), `ConsoleShell.tsx` L480 (`SystemRedirect`), `home/QuickActions.tsx` L58, `AppSidebar.tsx` L360 (`sys-settings`), L518 (no-app header), L760 (user menu), `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` L345 (`sys-settings`). All are unchanged and every one lands on `SettingsHub` via the new route. Each href pin the PR table names exists at head (`appSidebarSettingsTargets` L186/L203, `QuickActions.settingsTarget` L115, `systemRedirectTarget` L57, `systemNavSettingsTarget` L243, `noAppsCta`).

**Test-surface handover.** Compared against the two deleted suites (`git show cdefa2a06:…/SystemHubPage.counts.test.tsx`, `…metadataCards.test.tsx`): the table is complete for what those suites asserted (5 object names, null-vs-0, per-card failure blanking, Metadata/Datasources one-hop, MEASUREMENT identity, CONTROL Applications). `metadata` stays pinned in both branches (`pseudoRouteSegments` L382 `/apps/ghost/metadata`, L487 `/apps/setup/metadata`; `noAppComponentRoutes` L359–362). `sys-users/orgs/roles` hops are pinned unchanged in `systemHubRoutes` describe "system-hub entries reach the framework system objects", both branches.
**Gap the PR does not account for:** the handover covers what the deleted TESTS pinned, not what the deleted WALL produced. The wall's 13 cards also produced `system/audit-log`, `system/ai-approvals`, `system/profile`, `developer`, `system/marketplace`. After this PR, `system/audit-log` (`AuditLogPage`), `system/ai-approvals` (`AiPendingActionsPage`) and `/apps/:app/developer` (`DeveloperHubPage`) have zero in-app producers in objectui (grep of app-shell + console non-test: only the three `Route` declarations) and none in the framework nav (objectstack grep: `nav_audit_logs` targets object `sys_audit_log`, a different URL; `developer:*` are Studio componentRefs to the sub-pages, not the hub). Profile/approvals/marketplace/apps keep producers. The PR discloses "bookmark-only" for `positions`/`permissions` only. This is by the ruling's design (nav is the SSOT) and `check:unreferenced-sources` is import-graph, not nav, reachability — but it is an undisclosed discoverability regression that needs a filed follow-up (framework nav entries or console retirement of those three pages).

**Out-of-surface edits.** Mechanical check over `git diff cdefa2a06 0ebfc8ea7 -- file` changed lines: `systemNavSettingsTarget.test.tsx` 12 changed / 0 non-comment; `systemNavDatasourcesHop.test.tsx` 4 / 0. Comment-only, as declared. (Same check on app-shell `AppContent.tsx`: 14 / 0, all inside one `{/* #3590 … */}` block; and `noAppComponentRoutes.test.tsx` 7 / 0.) Note `noAppsCta.test.tsx` is NOT comment-only (stub test id, test names, assertions changed) but it is inside the claim.

**Undisclosed stale comments:** `apps/console/src/registerAccountComponents.tsx` L19–20 still justifies the `/system/profile` route with "Console-shell's System Hub still links to it directly" — now false, console source, outside the claim, not in the report. App-shell source comments still call the URL "the system hub" (`AppSidebar.tsx` L345/L511/L755, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` L330, `QuickActions.tsx` L56) while the PR rewrote the same phrase elsewhere.

**`Clause-②: no`.** `apps/console/package.json`: `exports` = `{"." : plugin.d.ts / plugin.js}` only; `plugin.ts` imports only `node:url`, `node:path`. So `SystemHubPage` is in no published entry — holds. Nuance: `files` includes `dist` and `prepublishOnly: pnpm build` runs `vite build`, so the published tarball's `dist/` does change (one lazy chunk gone, redirect in). That is a shipped-behaviour change the changeset documents, not an export/schema/accept-set change; `no` stands as the claim defines it.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/console` is in `.changeset/config.json` `fixed` (39 packages incl. `@object-ui/app-shell`), so `patch` on console bumps app-shell's version anyway; omitting app-shell only omits a CHANGELOG line, which is honest because its sole edit is a JSX comment (0 non-comment lines, verified above). AGENTS.md L168 requires one declaration per change when `src/` of a fixed-group package moves; `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` header confirms "a changeset was added" satisfies it; `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are green on head. AGENTS.md L271 forbids `major`; `patch` complies. `patch` is defensible (URL keeps resolving; consolidation); `minor` would also have been arguable since a shipped page is removed. Not blocking.
- Changeset prose, sentence by sentence: all eight sentences are true. "the legacy `/system` bookmark … now land[s] on the settings hub" is true via two hops. "Every link that used to open the hub still works" is true and silently one-directional — links FROM the hub to audit-log / ai-approvals / developer are the ones that vanish (see ①).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Declared narrowing** is sound in its runtime half (comment-only app-shell edit, verified) and honest about its blind spot; CI `Test (shard 1/8 … 8/8)` will run the other 531 app-shell files. **Eager-closure** is not un-measured: `performance-budget.yml` runs as check `Bundle Analysis` on `pull_request` and is `in_progress` on this head.
- **CI on `0ebfc8ea7`:** 42 check-runs — 27 `success` (incl. Changeset ×4, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Line Citation Gate, Build & E2E, Test (dist pins), Docs Route Eager Closure Check), 3 `skipped` (coverage ×2, dependabot), **12 `in_progress`: Lint, Type Check, Test shards 1/8–8/8, Bundle Analysis, Spec Main Shape Gate.** PR is draft, `mergeable_state: behind`.
- **Out-of-scope findings confirmed** at head: `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` L90 (page tree), L350 (`system → SystemHubPage` route table), L431 ("Default answer" quotes the deleted `@deprecated` docblock — that guidance now has no anchor); `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` L304; `ROADMAP.md` 7 lines (L812, 840, 852, 856, 864, 869, 872). Governed → the seat's docs PR must follow.
- **Should be filed before or with landing (not blocking the ruling's execution):** (a) the three orphaned routes `system/audit-log`, `system/ai-approvals`, `developer` — decide nav entries or retirement; (b) `registerAccountComponents.tsx` L19–20 false comment; (c) the search/hash-dropping sentence on `SystemLandingRedirect` for the `/system?…` bookmark; (d) PR assignee unset (dev deviation, process only).
- Nothing found that makes the code wrong for the ruling it executes; landing waits on the 12 in-progress checks.
